topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I walked through the quiet streets of our old neighborhood, the sun casting long shadows. It’s strange, the way time makes familiar paths seem foreign. I stopped by the old oak tree, the one we carved our names into, thinking it would last forever. The names are still there, etched deep, but when I called your number, the voice on the other end was like a stranger. I told myself maybe the years just dulled the edges of your memory, but as I stood there, the silence seemed to stretch out, making the space between us feel wider than ever.
